description:
What is This Part?
These are the CONE WASHERS that fit onto the Locking Hub Installation Bolts.
INCLUDES Two Full Sets of Cone Washers (Does BOTH Locking Hubs)
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 12 – Cone Washers
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
